had a deeply upsetting experience at this clinic two months ago. After being exposed to a severe allergen, my asthma was triggered badly. I could barely walk or speak due to shortness of breath, but I managed to get myself to the GP, hoping for urgent help.

When I arrived, I explained my situation to the receptionist and asked to see a doctor, even offering to wait as long as needed. Despite clearly struggling to breathe, I was told I needed an appointment and was turned away. The earliest appointment offered was for the next day. No concern was shown for my immediate condition, and I was simply sent away.

In the end, I had to call an ambulance because I was in no state to help myself further. This experience left me feeling helpless and incredibly disappointed. I understand procedures exist, but some level of compassion and discretion should be used when someone is clearly in distress.",null,[0,235]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VLckNnZWFOOWN6TndnRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xfa9562e3a5b617b8!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEKrCgeaN9czNwgE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VLckNnZWFOOWN6TndnRRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VLckNnZWFOOWN6TndnRRItChZDSUhNMG9nS0VQN2RncUxCcVo3bVp3EhNDZ3dJaVllV3dRWVF5SVdfd0FNGi0KFkNJSE0wb2dLRU9TeWlOYXQzUF84ZncSE0Nnd0lpWWVXd1FZUXlJV193QU0iEgkAAAAAAAAAABG4F7al42KV-ioTQ2d3SWlZZVd3UVlReUlXX3dBTQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwj_w8DHybKTAxV1RoQGHZe_IPQQoykICigB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwj_w8DHybKTAxV1RoQGHZe_IPQQ0pMFCAgoAg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMnQwWkdrd2NsOWZSV2hFTWpJMlQzZEtOVXBFWDNkeVNrSndhMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpqTUVOaFV6RXlURk56V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURvaDc2RHFnRRAB",["0x0:0xfa9562e3a5b617b8",null,1745928539415949,1745928539415949,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113076204930635646538/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["MICHAEL LEEDS","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKP1W5CHzj_dEcC2ioqRPgmWRcW8QdRlJrcyMn-Iu8moXaTIw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113076204930635646538?hl=en"],"113076204930635646538",null,6,0,null,[0,3,1],2,["6 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwj_w8DHybKTAxV1RoQGHZe_IPQQ7LoGCAwoAA"]]]],null,"10 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[4],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["My wife & I have had our odd issues with the surgery but have always had polite and efficent communication with reception staff, both on the phone and in the surgery.
